parent_objective: run three-seed fixed-budget public profile pilot after one-seed plumbing pass and audit
blocked_by: M1387 admits exactly one 3-seed public pilot as a stability check before another audit
supersedes: using M1386 one-seed trends as architecture ranking
running repeated profile pilots without audit

public_gates: M1388 may run exactly three fixed-budget seeds per corrected profile
M1388 must use the same seed offsets and public eval seeds for every profile
M1388 must record failed profiles instead of omitting them
M1388 must not promote, use private holdout, tune profiles, export corpus, or claim paper-level/profile-ranking evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune hyperparameters after seeing profile results
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim recurrent-belief advantage before audit
do not claim architecture ranking directly from this run

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs three fixed-budget public seeds per corrected profile to test one-seed trend stability
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public pilot trend only; no promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop after this run for audit before any further profile scaling
stop if any profile fails and route to repair
stop if fixed protocol changes after seeing a profile result
fallback_plan: if all profiles complete, route to result audit
if one or more profiles fail, record failures and route to focused repair
if runtime is excessive, audit resource usage before scaling
if parity persists, route to stronger causal history diagnostics rather than another blind repeat

admission_evidence: M1385 runtime smoke provides pretrain capability evidence that corrected controls instantiate
M1386 provides posttrain capability evidence that all eight profiles complete one fixed-budget train/eval seed
M1387 provides exact public gate discipline by requiring a result audit before this 3-seed pilot and no claim expansion
M1387 provides rollback and repair protection by requiring repair if any profile fails, metrics are non-finite, or parity signals persist without a stronger diagnostic
blocked_shortcuts: do not make profile-ranking, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: all 24 profile seed runs complete or failures are recorded
profile seed rows and aggregate rows are recorded
claim scope remains public pilot trend only

profile_pilot_protocol.eval_seed_policy: same 64 public eval seeds for every profile checkpoint

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1388 includes current-tiled L2 controls and corrected L3 reset-control but remains public trend evidence only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Three public training seeds and 64 public eval seeds per profile.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If controls match or beat normal profiles, record it and route to stronger causal diagnostics or task redesign instead of weakening claim standards.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, paper-result, or architecture-ranking claim before audit

hypothesis: A three-seed fixed-budget public profile pilot can test whether M1386 one-seed profile trends are stable without profile-specific tuning or claim expansion.
success_criteria: no promotion or actor-input contract change occurs
claims are limited to public profile trend
failure_criteria: profile-specific budgets or hyperparameters change after seeing results
metrics are framed as architecture-ranking or paper-level evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
failed profiles are omitted from summary
corrected controls are not applied in training or evaluation

decision_rule: M1388 passes if all 24 corrected profile seed runs complete with finite metrics and no claim expansion or protocol drift.
